Public Comment: The public is encouraged to address the Housing Authority on any matter listed on the agenda or on any other matter
within its jurisdiction subject to the rules of decorum described in Section 2.08.020 of the Norwalk Municipal Code. If you wish to address
the Housing Authority, please complete the card that is provided at the rear entrance to Council Chambers and hand the card to the
Sergeant at Arms. The Housing Authority will hear public comment on items listed on the agenda during discussion of the matter and
prior to a vote. The Housing Authority will hear public comment on matters not listed on the agenda during the Oral Communications
period.

Pursuant to provisions of the Brown Act, no action may be taken on a matter unless it is listed on the agenda, or unless certain emergency
or special circumstances exist. The Housing Authority may direct staff to investigate and/or schedule certain matters for consideration
at a future Housing Authority meeting.

Please adhere to the following procedures when addressing the Housing Authority:
  ♦ Comments should be limited to 3 minutes or less.
  ♦ Comments should be directed to the Housing Authority as a whole and not directed to individual Commissioners.

Americans with Disabilities Act: In compliance with the ADA, if you need special assistance to participate in a City meeting or other
services offered by this City, please contact the City Clerk’s office, (562) 929-5720. Assisted listening devices are available at this
meeting. Ask the City Clerk if you desire to use this device. Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be
made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability. Notification of at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time
when services are needed will assist the City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide accessibility to the
meeting or service.

Note: Any writings and/or documents provided to a majority of the Housing Authority regarding any item on this agenda after it has been
posted will also be made available for public inspection.

Writings and/or documents are available for inspection in the City Clerk’s Department, City Hall, 12700 Norwalk Boulevard during regular
business hours, 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday – Thursday and 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., every other Friday; telephone (562) 929-5720.
You may also contact the City Clerk via e-mail at recordsrequests@norwalkca.gov.

   ATTACHMENT 1

  Housing Authority
  Check Summary Information Sheet

The warrants in the Housing Authority agenda report are for housing assistance payments made
under the Section 8 Housing Choice Voucher program. The payee has a choice of receiving the
housing assistance payment via direct deposit, which is an electronic fund transfer made directly
to the payee’s bank account, or by paper check.

In the check summary report, the direct deposits are listed first as direct deposits, and then the
checks follow. Each direct deposit and paper check represents payment for 1 to 20 tenants
depending upon the number of Section 8 tenants the payee has.

The payee is the property owner or designated Management Company. The property owner or
manager may be a corporation, partnership, trust, or individual. The payee name is the owner or
manager’s legal business or individual name, which must match Internal Revenue Service (IRS)
records. Here are some common abbreviations used in business names:

LLC= Limited Liability Company

LP= Limited Partnership

DBA= “Doing Business As”

LTD= Limited

Checks made out to the City of Norwalk Housing represent the Family Self Sufficiency (FSS)
escrow deposits. These checks are deposited into the Housing Authority’s bank account here the
funds earn interest and are kept in escrow until the FSS participant successfully completes the
program at which time they receive the balance of their account.

Norwalk Housing Investors, LP is the owner of Center Pointe Villas at 14100 San Antonio and
11856 Orange. Payments are for Section 8 participants living in these buildings.

Payments to Housing authorities, such as Orange County Housing Authority and San Bernardino
County Housing, represent reimbursements for our participants who have transferred to those
jurisdictions under portability.

Please call Stephanie Ruiz Fender at ext. 5648 if you have any questions.
